title: Seven shortened cyclic fields with a 712-operation pair-table cube

claims.statement: The explicit 7-field degree-143 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-142 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5808462030158777248264341175977/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=9696361624460279422229763503205612703275629028686308275637864 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(1356361/6695).
